tabs.label: Lore
tabs.title: Assorted lore
list: Jibby2k1 is a middle-school tribute to Jimin, my favourite member of BTS. He was known for a certain asset, and I took the name. It stuck.

The photo at the top of this page is from the grand opening of Malachowsky Hall at UF. I showed up trying to vibe-match Jensen Huang's leather jacket, then was so star-struck I could not say a single word to him.

Doral Academy: Mu Alpha Theta, FAMAT, AMC and AIME, plus proof-based competitions around Florida. I was also in Zeta Omicron and the Robotics Society, and I founded the school's Physics-Chemistry Club.
tabs.outro: There is an easter egg on this page. ↑ ↑ ↓ ↓ ← → ← → B A (on a phone, tap the motto three times).
